title: The Snow Hare
text: A white hare sits in the snow ahead and does not run. It watches the party with a man's eyes, brown and sad and knowing. When you stop, it stops; when you move, it hops a little way ahead.

options.label: Follow the hare; it seems to want you to.

outcomes.text: It leads you to a hidden cave, warm and dry, and then it is gone.
It leads you to a hunter's snare, then watches from the drift.

options.label: The wisest speaks to it to learn what it once was.

outcomes.text: It is a shapeshifter, sad and tired, and it warns you of what lies ahead.

options.label: Hunt the hare; meat is meat, whatever its eyes.
